name: BitMine Immersion Technologies, Inc.
moat_justification: No durable moat: the business is now holding and staking Ethereum — a commodity asset anyone can buy directly or via an ETF — with no switching costs, no pricing power, and no proprietary operating franchise; the legacy mining/equipment business earned $6.095M of revenue in FY2025 against an $8.795B balance sheet. Scale as the largest ETH treasury (about 4.9% of supply, search results) and the MAVAN staking platform earn 1 rather than 0, but staking yield is the protocol rate available to every holder. Measured returns confirm no franchise: fundamentals.json roic_proxy was -73.43% in 2021, -19.31% in 2022, -31.84% in 2023, -53.91% in 2024 and +4.29% in 2025 — and the single positive year is a non-cash mark-to-market artifact, not operating returns — while gross margin fell from 34.48% in 2023 to 22.99% in 2024 to 5.09% in 2025 on the tiny revenue base.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 14 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 17.1%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
BASIS_BREAK_SUSPECT: a >60% revenue jump/drop in the last 5 yrs — check for divestitures, big M&A, or restatements before trusting any CAGR
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

DEBT_TAGS_BLANK: no debt tag reports for the latest fiscal year — net debt is UNKNOWN (not zero); no leverage verdict is possible from the engine, state the balance sheet from the filing in analysis.md
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low
one_liner: Ethereum treasury vehicle, moat 1/10, with no positive owner's earnings in any of the last 5 years or on TTM (normalized base -$0.31/share, TTM -$0.75/share) — Tier F on this screen; it is a levered-by-dilution ETH NAV proxy, not an OE compounder, does not clear 15%, and no hurdle-clearing price is computable on a negative OE base.
moat_for: Largest Ethereum treasury globally — about 6.02M ETH, about 4.9% of supply, with total crypto, cash and marketable securities of $17.4B as of Oct 4, 2026 (search results)
MAVAN staking scale — 5,067,309 ETH staked, a staking operation few listed peers match (search results)
Exceptional equity-market access and liquidity — repeated weekly ETH accumulation since June 30, 2025 funded by equity issuance, plus Russell 1000 inclusion (search results)
moat_against: Commodity exposure — ETH can be bought directly or via ETFs; no switching costs, lock-in, network effect owned by BMNR, or pricing power
No operating earnings power — FY2025 revenue $6.095M; conservative OE negative in 0/5 positive years and TTM OE -$334.023M; value is NAV, not cash flow

Measured ROIC deeply negative in 2021-2024 (roic_proxy -73.43% / -19.31% / -31.84% / -53.91%) and the +4.29% in 2025 is unrealized ETH gains, not franchise returns; gross margin collapsed to 5.09% in 2025

Extreme dilution funds the model — weighted diluted shares 24,515,226 in FY2025 vs 443,947,604 weighted in the current YTD period (ttm.json) and 603,226,394 shares outstanding at 2026-07-09; $11.87B of share issuance in the nine months to 2026-05-31 (fundamentals.json)
Single-asset concentration — earnings and NAV swing billions with the ETH price (TTM net income -$8,754,771,609 in fundamentals.json)
